finalAudit.method: BVH AABB candidates, triangle-plane intersection interval overlap, 2D coplanar clipping; strictly transverse interior crossings separated from contact and coplanar overlap.
limits: A discrete surface audit does not certify continuous collision or finite-thickness clearance.
Only contacts confined to geometrically coincident shared vertices or shared edges are excluded. Crossings away from shared vertices remain tested.
Coplanar overlaps and nonlocal boundary contacts require review rather than being silently accepted.
Point-inside distances use the supplied body collider and require a closed body mesh.

scope: Native Rapier 0.21.0 cloth simulation, native single-particle cluster spherical stitches, unchanged 2D structural rest, exact reference MakeHuman mesh contact.
limitations: Small meshes and 30-step discrete audit samples do not certify a complete garment.
The chest probe accelerates cloth along the surface normal to isolate body contact. It does not test wearing under vertical gravity.
No material calibration, arbitrary self-entanglement guarantee, swept collision proof, or CLO certification.
Seam joints couple particle locations. They do not add seam-line bending or a fabric sewing material model.
No runtime topology edits are implemented. Recreate the engine after topology changes.
